name: Phantom
description: Open-source engineering agent workbench: coding-agent chats and workspaces, local model discovery, signed resident autonomy on macOS, and cloud lanes for Claude and Devin.
capabilities: fleet outcomes with explicit acceptance criteria
signed resident autonomy on macOS (dormant until a Touch-ID-signed grant; the default ladder starts in shadow)
local model discovery through Ollama and llama.cpp
MCP stdio aggregation gateway and registry management
cloud lanes for Claude sessions and Devin under explicit budgets
offline run receipts and benchmark comparison

commands.phm verse: open the workbench console (loopback only, startup token required)
commands.phm docs --agent --json: command registry for agents: usage, safety class, JSON shapes
commands.phm mcp: MCP aggregation gateway and registry management
commands.phm authority setup: resident autonomy setup on macOS under a signed grant
commands.phm devin connect: connect the optional Devin cloud lane

tools: phm CLI (ashlr is a compatible alias)
macOS desktop app (locally signed, not notarized)
